mistake_reason: The orchestrator approved the result using defective verification criteria: it treated the summary category "missing ≤1" (which includes both those missing 0 and those missing 1) as equivalent to "only missing a single qualification." The verification phase checked only that totals reconciled (7 + 24 + 9 = 40) and that samples predominated in the ≤1 threshold, rather than validating the exact count for "exactly one." This constitutes Incorrect Verification (FM-3.3): misinterpreting category semantics and applying an irrelevant check that inevitably passes, leading to a false confirmation of an objectively incorrect answer.
